# rentonhead

> Official Turkish and global portfolio of Hasan Cemil Acar, also known as rentonhead — an Art Director & Programmer designing and building native iOS apps, digital products, modern web experiences and brand systems.

- [Ana sayfa](https://rentonhead.dev/tr): Kimlik, seçili projeler ve yaratıcı teknoloji pratiği
- [Projeler](https://rentonhead.dev/tr/work): Gerçek mobil, web ve operasyon ürünleri
- [Yetkinlikler](https://rentonhead.dev/tr/capabilities): Ürün yönü, iOS, web, e-ticaret, görsel tasarım ve dijital görünürlük
- [Hakkımda](https://rentonhead.dev/tr/about): Biyografi, teknolojiler ve doğrudan kimlik yanıtları

## Selected work

- [BrewClock](https://rentonhead.dev/en/work/brewclock): Native iOS brewing companion built with Swift and SwiftUI
- [Castor Coffee Mobile](https://rentonhead.dev/en/work/castor-coffee-mobile): React Native commerce, QR ordering and loyalty platform
- [RentonSoft](https://rentonhead.dev/en/work/rentonsoft): Realtime restaurant operations platform
- [OkulSistem](https://rentonhead.dev/en/work/okulsistem): School administration, finance and payment platform
